unit: px height of the front card's right edge (769 px = the card at rest front-on)
sampling: captured pictures only (24/30 fps cadence on the 60 fps grid)
note: S03 card deck: height of the front card's right edge on the second (settled) picture of each new card (scratch/v8c2_S03_stack_geom.csv -> v8c2_S03_deck_settled.csv); after a zoom-out to 485 px (f1140) the camera pushes in with an accelerating ease-in to 785 px (x1.62) at f1172, and the last card lands at f1174 already larger than the frame; to-value = last measured picture (no settle, the move ends in the landing)
